_comment: News sources the advisor cross-references. Each source lists one or more RSS feeds. If every feed fails or returns nothing, googleNewsQuery is used as a fallback (Google News RSS search restricted to that site). fullText=true fetches the article page for more context and is only enabled for outlets without a hard paywall.

sources.name: BBC
sources.googleNewsQuery: site:bbc.com business OR economy OR markets

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.googleNewsQuery: site:aljazeera.com economy OR business OR markets

sources.name: Business Insider
sources.googleNewsQuery: site:businessinsider.com markets OR stocks OR economy

sources.name: Forbes
sources.googleNewsQuery: site:forbes.com investing OR markets OR stocks

sources.name: New York Times
sources.googleNewsQuery: site:nytimes.com business OR economy OR markets

sources.name: Wall Street Journal
sources.googleNewsQuery: site:wsj.com markets OR economy OR business

sources.name: Associated Press
sources.googleNewsQuery: site:apnews.com business OR economy OR markets
